purpose: Display-only overrides for the rankings.csv development_stage column. Does NOT affect archetype, tier_commercial, stage_bucket, lead_program_phase, scoring, ranker, selector, eligibility, EES, Event EV, Module 5 cohorts, or QA gates. Audited each pipeline run via Spec 068.

MESO.evidence: Ryoncil (remestemcel-L) FDA-approved 2024-12-18 for steroid-refractory acute graft-versus-host disease in pediatric patients. Internal source module_4_lead_phase reports phase_3 (stale).

VCEL.evidence: MACI (autologous cultured chondrocytes) and Epicel commercial. financial_records.json Revenue=$276M, FY2025. Internal source module_4_lead_phase reports approved (one bucket below commercial).

HALO.evidence: ENHANZE drug delivery platform commercial; multiple partnered marketed products. financial_records.json Revenue=$1.4B, FY2025. Internal source module_4_lead_phase reports approved (one bucket below commercial).

MLYS.evidence: Lorundrostat NDA submission per pdufa_dates_extracted.json (PDUFA pending). Internal source module_4_lead_phase reports phase_3 (stale).

INSM.evidence: Brensocatib (BRINSUPRI) FDA-approved 2025-08-12 for non-cystic fibrosis bronchiectasis (NDA 217673). Commercially launched in US, EU, UK, and Japan (MHLW approval Aug 2026, Japan launch Oct 2026). Q3 2026 global BRINSUPRI revenue grew 29% QoQ. Source: FDA approval letter; Insmed Q3 2026 earnings 2026-10-29. Internal source module_4_lead_phase reports phase_3 (stale — references pre-approval trial records).

IMCR.evidence: KIMMTRAK (tebentafusp-tebn) FDA-approved for HLA-A*02:01+ metastatic uveal melanoma; launched in 30+ markets. Q3 2026 net sales $102M; YTD 2026 net sales $325M (+10% YoY). Source: Immunocore Q3 2026 earnings 2026-11-07. Internal source module_4_lead_phase reports phase_3 (stale — KIMMTRAK approval not reflected; active Phase 3 trials TEBE-AM and ATOM are expansion indications).

ANRO.evidence: Alto Neuroscience has no approved products. Stage classifier picked up two PHASE4/WITHDRAWN ClinicalTrials.gov trials (Duloxetine and Sertraline EEG studies, withdrawn 2023) that predate company formation — these are not Alto products. Lead program ALTO-207 (pramipexole + ondansetron) is in Phase 2b (PACE-1, NCT not on trial_records for this ticker), with topline data guided 2H 2027. Phase 3 initiation planned early 2027. Source: Alto Neuroscience Q2 2026 10-Q 2026-08-11; Sep 2026 corporate deck.
